Container.Name: alexa-plex-proxy
Container.Overview: Private Alexa music gateway for Plex. Searches your local Plex music library and serves short-lived signed audio streams to an Alexa custom skill without exposing the Plex token to Alexa or AWS.
Container.Requires: If the GHCR package is private, authenticate Unraid to ghcr.io with a GitHub classic PAT that has read:packages. The gateway must also be exposed through a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy for Alexa playback.

Config.Name: Gateway port
Config.Description: Local HTTP port for the Plex gateway. Route your public HTTPS hostname to this port through a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Plex server URL
Config.Description: Local URL for Plex Media Server. Replace the example IP with the address reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Authentication token for your Plex account. This remains inside the gateway container.

Config.Name: Plex music library
Config.Description: Exact name of the Plex music library to search.

Config.Name: Gateway API key
Config.Description: Long random bearer token shared with the Alexa Lambda. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: Stream signing secret
Config.Description: Different long random secret used to sign expiring audio URLs. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: Maximum stream URL lifetime
Config.Description: Maximum accepted lifetime of a signed stream URL, in seconds.

Config.Name: Maximum queue tracks
Config.Description: Maximum tracks returned for an artist, album, or playlist. The application caps this at 500.

Config.Name: Container port
Config.Description: Internal Node.js listening port. Keep this aligned with the gateway port mapping.

Config.Name: Node environment
Config.Description: Run the gateway in production mode.
